fold.text: Skip to content Wanwen Li Home Projects Experience About Photography 中文 Get in touch Understanding the work . Building what helps . Hi, I’m Wanwen. After 4+ years growing Amazon stores, including three running my own, I’m learning to build: marketing automation and data tools, made with AI-assisted coding. Open to internships from Nov 2026 Get to know me ↗ ✦ ✧ Click to meet me Marketing workflows · AI-assisted building Business context · Data & implementation Real local test screens Payment & shipping simulated Featured case · Working local prototype Lifecycle Email Automation A consent-aware post-purchase email journey for Petal / Atelier, a fictional DTC soap brand. Designed, built and tested end to end on my laptop. 1 A journey that reacts Welcome → dispatch → a recommendation if she clicks her scent, a gentle reminder if she doesn’t. 2 Consent first No marketing consent, no promotional emails. Only order updates are sent. 3 Tested, with limits written down All three paths (3 / 3 / 2 emails), duplicate orders, reset and restart recovery. n8n Node.js + SQLite Dittofeed Mailpit Docker Read the case View on GitHub Screens from a sanitised local copy Private prototype Featured case · Working prototype London Home Finder A personal tool that brings London rental listings from 20 agency sources into one map, with filters, a shortlist and a daily email. 1 Data from 20 sources 19 collected automatically every day; the last good data is kept if a run fails. 2 Search the way people decide

fold.text: Skip to content Wanwen Li Home Projects Experience About Photography 中文 Get in touch A bit about me Business context. Builder curiosity. I’m Wanwen, based in Torino, Italy. I grew Amazon stores for 4+ years and I’m now retraining as a builder. I know the marketing side from the inside: listings, advertising budgets, pricing, inventory and reading customer reviews. At Politecnico di Torino I’m learning Python, SQL and cloud basics, and I use AI coding assistants to turn marketing workflows into working tools. I’m a career changer, not a senior engineer, and I say so plainly. See my work ↗ Read my résumé The person behind the blue hat. From operator to builder Why I’m changing direction, and what I bring with me. 2019 – 2024 Running the numbers At Sunlu, the new store I ran ranked #1 in Prime Day 2020 sales growth among all company stores. I then founded and ran my own Amazon store for three years: product selection, listings, ads, pricing and stock. 2024 – now Learning to build I kept hitting the same wall: the tools I needed didn’t exist, or I couldn’t change them. So I went back to study. MSc at Politecnico di Torino: Python (30/30), databases, IoT and cloud. Now Proving it with projects A rental aggregator with daily data collection, and a consent-aware lifecycle email journey built with n8n and Dittofeed. AI helps me write code; the design decisions, testing and documented limits are mine. What I’m looking for Internships from November 2026, in English-speaking teams in Europe or remote. These are the roles where my experience fits today:

h3: Why it matters for marketing roles
outline: Why it matters for marketing roles

fold.text: Skip to content Wanwen Li Home Projects Experience About Photography 中文 Get in touch My workbench Real problems. Things I’m building. From a scattered rental search to a lifecycle email journey. I’m learning to take a need, build a tool and improve it with evidence. 50-second walkthrough · real local test screens Lifecycle Email Automation Working local prototype Lifecycle Email Automation A consent-aware post-purchase email journey for Petal / Atelier, a fictional DTC soap brand selling to Germany, France and Italy. Built with n8n, Node.js + SQLite, Dittofeed and a local Mailpit inbox. View on GitHub ↗ The business problem A one-time €9.90 discovery box is an easy first purchase. The question is how to turn that first order into interest in a second one, without emailing people who didn’t opt in. The journey I designed A welcome email confirms the order. The dispatch email invites her to explore her scent. If she clicks, a recommendation follows; if not, a gentle reminder. Without marketing consent, only the two order emails are sent. Why it matters for FDE The role in miniature: turn a marketing brief into a journey, choose and connect the tools, test every branch and write down the limits. Built with AI coding assistance. A personal project, not a client deployment. Green: running locally. Peach: simulated. Purple: planned, not connected. Scope, tests & limits Tested Three paths delivered 3 / 3 / 2 emails as designed. Duplicate orders ignored, invalid emails rejected, safe callbacks after reset, full stop-and-restart recovery.
